bar.tiles.tooltip: Tiles: the list of the map's tiles, with a search; click one to select it.
bar.project.tooltip: The project and the map it edits. Click for the map's settings, description and counts.
bar.paths.tooltip: AI paths: show the paths by kind and go to the open ends. The Paths switch at the left shows them on the map.
bar.entries.tooltip: Entry points: where buses start; place, rename and delete them.
bar.lines.tooltip: Lines: the lines of the timetable, the timetable editor and the vehicle groups.
bar.chrono.tooltip: Chrono: variants of the map with their dates; show the map on a date or edit a variant.
bar.map.tooltip: Map: name, size, settings, parking list, traffic curves and the description of the map.
context.properties.tooltip: Open the inspector with the position, orientation and settings of this element.
context.readonly: Read-only: save a MapWorks project to edit.
